title: Create and update accept empty and invalid data for products, carts and users
description: The system creates products, carts and users even when the form is empty or clearly wrong - a price written as text or below zero, a picture link that isn't a link, a cart for a customer or product that doesn't exist, a negative or zero quantity, an email that isn't an email, an account with no password - and says 'created successfully'. It should refuse and say which detail is wrong.
steps: POST /products with {} / price "abc" / price -10 / image "not a url" -> 201; PUT /products/1 price "abc" -> 200
POST /carts with {} / userId "abc" / products "x" / quantity 0 -> 201; PUT /carts/1 quantity -5 -> 200
POST /users with {} / email "not-an-email" / no password -> 201; PUT /users/2 email "bad" -> 200
expected: 400 with a field-level message (spec types: price number, image uri, userId integer, products array; plus existing user/product, quantity >= 1, valid email, password required).
actual: 201/200 and the invalid values are echoed back.
